title: Letter Re Yup Yuk

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
C. & S. B. REGISTR
D. 2152
20 / 7 / 32

July 20 32.

My dear Steptoe,

With reference to Mrs. Hatherly's letter of
July 12, I am sending you herewith a copy of a report
made by a member of the Special Branch which shows
that Yup Yuk alias Yup Meuk Fun, the deportee from
Calcutta who was expected to come here by the s.s.
"Tilawa", was taken off the ship by the Hongkong Police.

Yours sincerely,

Enccl:- 1 copy. Sent 20/7.
D.S.D.

H. N. Steptoe, Esq.,
British Consulate-General.

上海工部局
C. & S. B. 登记处
D. 2152
32年7月20日

1932年7月20日。

亲爱的斯蒂普托（Steptoe）：

关于哈瑟利（Hatherly）夫人7月12日的来信，现随函附上工部局警务处特务科一名成员所作报告的副本。该报告显示，预计将乘坐“蒂拉瓦”号（s.s. "Tilawa"）轮船抵达此地的加尔各答被驱逐者叶煜（Yup Yuk，又名叶木芬 Yup Meuk Fun），已被香港警方从船上带走。

此致
敬礼

附件：副本一份。已于7月20日发出。
D.S.D.

H. N. Steptoe 先生，
英国总领事馆。

1932.

Subject (in full)........................................ Attached Letter ref Yup Yuk.

Made by...... D.S. Moore. ....................... Forwarded by... [Signature]

Regarding attached letter from the British Consulate-
General concerning a Chinese communist named Yup Yuk alias
Yur Neuk Fun who was deported from Calcutta on s.s. "Tilawa"
for Shanghai on June 30, 1932. The s.s. "Tilawa" arrived
in this port during the afternoon July 19 and was met by
the undersigned and representatives of the Public Safety Bureau.
It was then ascertained that Yur Yuk had been removed from the
vessel by the Hongkong Police on July 15, 1932. The following
are copies of the receipts held by the purser of s.s. "Tilawa."

British Indian Steam Navigation Co.
s.s. "Tilawa" Voyage No.42

Calcutta. June 30, 1932.

Received from inspector, King George Dock Police one
Chinese Deportee named Yup Yuk alias Yup Fun alias Neuk alias
Yok Ya Hung alias John Jameson, bound for Shanghai together
with the sum of Rupees 25 and Annas 14 only, one deck passage
ticket No.5629 and Certificate of Identity No.16, dated
Calcutta the 30th of June 1932.

(Signed) D. Lome
Chief Officer.

Received from Purser s.s. "Tilawa" the sum of Rupees 25
and Annas 14 being the property of Yup Yuk.

(Signed) R. Ellis L.S.A. 150
Police Headquarters.
Hongkong.
15-7-32.

The Purser of s.s. "Tilawa" informed the undersigned he
pointed out to the Hongkong Police that Yup Yuk was booked for
Shanghai and was told that the Hongkong Police had received

主题（全称）........................................ 附信，涉及叶煜（Yup Yuk）。

制作人...... D.S. Moore ....................... 转呈人... [签名]

关于英国总领事馆就一名名为叶煜（Yup Yuk，又名 Yur Neuk Fun）的中国共产党员所附来函事宜。此人于1932年6月30日在加尔各答被驱逐，乘坐“蒂拉瓦”号（s.s. "Tilawa"）轮船前往上海。“蒂拉瓦”号于7月19日下午抵达本港，由下文署名者及公安局代表前往迎接。经查明，叶煜（Yur Yuk）已于1932年7月15日被香港警方从船上带走。以下为“蒂拉瓦”号轮船事务长持有的收据副本。

英属印度蒸汽航运公司
“蒂拉瓦”号轮船 第42航次

加尔各答。1932年6月30日。

收到乔治王码头（King George Dock）警察局督察移交的一名中国被驱逐者，名为叶煜（Yup Yuk），又名叶芬（Yup Fun）、纽克（Neuk）、叶亚洪（Yok Ya Hung）、约翰·詹姆森（John Jameson），目的地为上海，连同仅计25卢比14安那的款项、一张5629号统舱船票以及1932年6月30日签发于加尔各答的第16号身份证明书。

（签名）D. Lome
大副。

收到“蒂拉瓦”号轮船事务长移交的25卢比14安那款项，系叶煜（Yup Yuk）之财产。

（签名）R. Ellis L.S.A. 150
警察总部。
香港。
32年7月15日。

“蒂拉瓦”号轮船事务长告知下文署名者，他曾向香港警方指出叶煜已预订前往上海的船票，并被告知香港警方已收到

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C & S. B. REGISTRY
N. D 3852
H.B.M. Consulate General,
12/7/32
Shanghai,
July 12th 1932.

Dear Mr. Givens,

In Mr. Steptoe's absence I venture to
inform you that a telegram has just been received
from India to the effect that a Communist named
YUP YUK alias Yup Neuk Fun, of Mui Yuan district
Kwangtung, was deported from Calcutta on s.s. TILAWA
for Shanghai on June 30th. It is stated that he
twice escaped arrest after the Canton Communist
uprising about four years ago and eventually arrived
in Calcutta. He is alleged to be wanted by the
Chinese police.

Yours sincerely,
Hatters
(secretary)

T.P. Givens, Esq.,
Special Branch,
S.M.P.

S 2, For attention in Operations
with Chinese Authorities.
JW 12:7:32

上海工部局警务处
C & S. B. 登记处
N. D 3852
英国驻华总领事馆，
32年7月12日
上海，
1932年7月12日。

亲爱的吉文斯（Givens）先生：

趁斯蒂普托（Steptoe）先生不在之际，谨告知您，刚收到来自印度的电报，称一名名为叶煜（YUP YUK，又名 Yup Neuk Fun）的共产党员，籍贯广东梅县（Mui Yuan district Kwangtung），于6月30日在加尔各答被驱逐，乘坐“蒂拉瓦”号（TILAWA）轮船前往上海。据称，他在大约四年前的广州共产党暴动后两次逃脱逮捕，最终抵达加尔各答。据悉，中国警方正在通缉此人。

此致
敬礼
哈特斯（Hatters）
（秘书）

T.P. Givens 先生，
特务科，
上海工部局警务处。

S 2，提请在与
中国当局行动时注意。
JW 32年7月12日
